description: Repo scaffold: pinned PocketBase, the React + Vite + TypeScript app in web/, and a test harness that boots a throwaway PocketBase from pb_migrations/ and pb_hooks/
steps: POCKETBASE_VERSION holds the pinned version and the sha256 of its linux_amd64 zip (Kayden writes this file; the guard blocks Claude); scripts/fetch-pb.sh downloads that release and exits non-zero if the checksum doesn't match
package.json pins Node 24 in engines and .nvmrc says 24; npm ci --ignore-scripts installs; the only runtime dependencies are react, react-dom and pocketbase

web/ is a Vite + React + TypeScript (strict) app; npm run build runs tsc and vite build into pb_public/, which is gitignored; PocketBase serves it with an index fallback so client routes load on refresh (confirm the serve option on the pinned version and note it in progress.md)
npm run dev runs Vite with /api proxied to the local PocketBase on 127.0.0.1:8090, so development is same-origin like prod
package.json script check runs tsc --noEmit, npm test and npm run build in that order and stops at the first failure; it is the one command that says the work is green on the dev VM (decisions.md L3)
One shared PocketBase SDK client in web/src/lib/pb.ts, and one helper that corrects the phone's clock by the offset from the server's Date header (decisions.md 2026-10-05, server clock)

npm run build also writes pb_public/build.json ({"sha", "built_at"}; sha is "dev" outside CI), and the app shows the short sha in a small footer, so the deploy smoke tests and Kayden on staging can see which commit is running
npm test (Vitest) starts a fresh PocketBase in a temp directory with pb_migrations/ and pb_hooks/, runs every test file against it and shuts it down; two runs in a row both pass
Smoke test: the PocketBase health endpoint returns 200 (record the path used on the pinned version in progress.md)
Test helpers create the security.md fixture users (K, O, S, N, M, W, X, Y), act as each through the superuser impersonate endpoint (no email in tests), and act as anon
.gitignore covers the pocketbase binary, pb_data/, pb_public/, node_modules/, .env*, CLAUDE.local.md and .claude/settings.local.json; env.example exists
npm run check output shown, run twice

description: Migrations for all six collections with every field security.md v0.9 lists and every API rule locked (null); species seeded
steps: Collections users (auth), events, species, entries, catches and audit_log exist with exactly the fields in security.md 'Collections', including events.deadline_ext_min (default 0), events.code_word_prev and events.code_word_changed_at, catches.photo_captured_at, catches.flags and catches.rev, and the audit_log catch and event relations
users auth: OTP on, password and OAuth2 off; emailVisibility defaults to false; role is member or organizer; display_units is lb or lb_oz
catches.photo is a protected multi-file field: at most 4 files, image/jpeg only, 5 MB per file (the minimum of 2 is enforced by the S1 rule and hook)
Unique indexes: catches.client_uuid; entries (event, angler); species.name
Every list, view, create, update and delete rule is null on all six collections, and users.manageRule is null
Species seeded by migration: largemouth bass and smallmouth bass

A test boots from an empty pb_data, applies every migration from zero, and confirms anon and a signed-in member are refused for every collection and action (an early form of R-ALL-ANON-01; the full sweeps come with S1)
Migrations are new files only; Kayden reads every migration diff before merge
npm run check output shown

description: Spike: prove the photo pipeline and three rule mechanics on the pinned binary before S1 builds submit (decisions.md L2; security.md open item 7)
steps: Fixtures in test/fixtures/: gps.jpg (EXIF GPS), xmp-gps.jpg (XMP GPS), iphone.heic and text-chunk.png, plus two clean JPEGs for the required photos

The chosen server approach (A: exiftool through $os.cmd, if it can run in the prod LXC; or B: fail closed on any file that still carries location metadata) leaves no location data in any stored original or thumbnail, on a two-photo create and on an added photo; test/upload.test.ts proves it for all four fixtures

In the browser, DateTimeOriginal is read from each photo before re-encoding, on iPhone Safari (including an iPhone HEIC from the photo picker) and on Android Chrome; what each browser delivers is written down

A hook compares the new photo list with the stored one and refuses before PocketBase deletes any file (append-only); if that can't be done on the pinned version, say so (the fallback is retract-and-resubmit only)

On the pinned binary: @request.body.photo:length counts the uploaded files in a multipart create; the update hook can re-read rev inside the save transaction; judge.role resolves against the submitted body in the events create rule
Spike code stays off main unless it becomes the real implementation; the results, the chosen option and the reasons are drafted as a decisions.md row for Kayden to review and commit

description: Heartbeat hook, a bare OTP sign-in and a bare live list of catches that proves realtime works and admits when it is stale
steps: pb_hooks/heartbeat.pb.js sends a 'heartbeat' realtime message every minute to every client subscribed to it (dev-lifecycle-guide.md Phase 2 pattern)

Opens the list and view rules of events, entries and catches exactly as security.md v0.9 writes them, with their tests passing in the same commit (R-EVT-L-01 to R-EVT-L-03, R-EVT-V-01, R-ENT-L-01 to R-ENT-L-06, R-CAT-L-01 to R-CAT-L-08, R-CAT-L-10 to R-CAT-L-12, R-CAT-V-01); every other rule stays null
A bare sign-in page requests a PocketBase OTP code and accepts it (no design yet; the AUTH screens come with S1)

One React hook, web/src/lib/useLive.ts, subscribes to catches and to 'heartbeat', unsubscribes on unmount, refetches everything on PB_CONNECT and when the page becomes visible again, and polls every 30 s if nothing (not even a heartbeat) arrives for 150 s

A bare page lists the live event's pending and verified catches with a Live / Reconnecting / Updated h:mm badge; any event status shown uses the status words (Draft, Live, Closed, Final), kept apart from the badge (decisions.md 2026-10-05)
Locally, a catch added in the admin UI appears on the page without a reload
Checked at 390 px wide; npm run check output shown

description: The CI half of the pipeline in decisions.md L3: ci.yml with a bundle artifact on every push to main, a release job that attaches that artifact to a tag, the pre-push hook and the pull request template, drafted and tested for Kayden to install
steps: docs/drafts/ci.yml (Kayden copies it to .github/workflows/ci.yml; the guard blocks Claude there): runs on pull requests and pushes to main with Node 24; npm ci --ignore-scripts, scripts/fetch-pb.sh, npm test, npm run build, gitleaks; permissions contents: read; every action pinned to a full commit SHA

On a push to main, once the tests pass, the same workflow packages bundle.tar.gz (built pb_public/ with build.json, pb_hooks/, pb_migrations/, POCKETBASE_VERSION, and BUILD_INFO holding the commit SHA) with bundle.sha256 and uploads both as the artifact bundle-<sha>, kept 90 days; still contents: read. Pull request runs build but upload nothing

On a v* tag, a release job (the only job with contents: write, plus actions: read) checks the tagged commit is on main (git merge-base --is-ancestor against origin/main), finds that commit's successful ci.yml push run on main, downloads its bundle artifact, verifies the sha256 and attaches bundle.tar.gz and bundle.sha256 to the release. It never rebuilds, and it fails and attaches nothing if the commit isn't on main or has no green main build
Tests show the release job fails for a tag off main and for a commit with no green main build
docs/drafts/pre-push (Kayden installs it as .githooks/pre-push and runs git config core.hooksPath .githooks; .githooks/ is guard-protected): runs npm run check and refuses the push if it fails
.github/pull_request_template.md lists the Definition of Done: npm run check and CI green; every migration and rule diff read; any rule change has its security.md row and test in the same commit
npm run check output shown

description: The deploy half of the pipeline in decisions.md L3: deploy.sh for prod and for staging (--staging), the systemd units and the staging timer, and the staging seed script, drafted and tested locally against stubs for Kayden to install
steps: deploy.sh <tag> follows ops.md §5 in order: refuses while /etc/scoreboard/FREEZE exists unless --force; refuses a tag whose commit isn't on main (GitHub compare API: main...<tag> must be identical or behind); refuses while an event is live if the bundle adds migrations or changes POCKETBASE_VERSION; downloads with the read-only token from a root-only env file; verifies the sha256; backs up by stopping PocketBase and archiving pb_data to /var/backups/scoreboard/pre-deploy-<tag>-<time>.tar.zst; unpacks to releases/<tag>; verifies the PocketBase binary; switches the current symlink; starts; smoke-tests through Cloudflare with the service token (health endpoint and build.json sha); appends a deploy-log line; switches back if the smoke test fails

deploy.sh --staging follows ops.md §5: with the staging token, finds the newest successful ci.yml push run on main; exits quietly if that commit is already running; otherwise downloads and verifies the artifact, checks the commit is on main, backs up, unpacks to releases/<sha>, switches, starts, smoke-tests with the staging-probe token, switches back on failure, and pings the Healthchecks staging URL (its /fail URL on failure). It skips the FREEZE and live-event checks, and refuses to run unless /etc/scoreboard/ENVIRONMENT says staging

Tests show deploy.sh refuses an off-main tag against a stubbed compare response, and deploy.sh --staging deploys a new commit, does nothing for an unchanged one, and rolls back a failing smoke test, against stubbed GitHub and smoke endpoints
deploy.sh passes shellcheck and runs against a fake bundle in a temp directory with its network calls stubbed (never against prod or staging)

systemd drafts: the PocketBase unit runs as a non-root user on 127.0.0.1:8090 from the current symlink, with NoNewPrivileges, ProtectSystem=strict and write access only to pb_data; for staging, scoreboard-staging-deploy.service plus a .timer that runs deploy.sh --staging every 5 minutes

scripts/seed-staging, run by Kayden on staging only, creates the security.md fixture users (each with a name) and one live event through the staging superuser, and refuses to run unless /etc/scoreboard/ENVIRONMENT says staging
npm run check output shown

description: The pure scoring module: web/src/lib/scoring.ts computes standings from verified catches only, tested against the scoring.md examples; no UI, API rules or hooks
steps: web/src/lib/scoring.ts is pure, has no dependencies and uses integers only (weight_hoz, length_q); test/scoring.test.ts takes its fixtures straight from scoring.md (invariant 1)
Best 10, culls and pending: scoring.md examples 1, 2, 3 and 4 pass
Ties and shared places: scoring.md examples 8, 9, 10 and 11 pass
Withdrawn entries are left out of the standings, and a self-rejoin brings their verified fish back (scoring.md example 19)
Rejected and retracted catches never score and aren't counted as pending (scoring.md example 20)
A judge's correction of a verified catch re-culls: A goes from 28.05 to 27.60 (scoring.md example 21)
npm run check output shown

description: Kayden, by hand: prod and staging containers, network, tunnels, Access, SMTP, the pipeline install and the first deploys
steps: Unprivileged Debian LXC on the isolated prod VLAN with the ops.md §2 firewall; from the LXC a LAN host and the Proxmox UI are unreachable, and from the dev VM the LXC and the Proxmox UI are unreachable (output in docs/evidence/m0.txt)
cloudflared runs a named tunnel inside the LXC to 127.0.0.1:8090; the tunnel token is a root-only file there

Staging LXC on its own staging VLAN, set up like prod (/etc/scoreboard/ENVIRONMENT says staging): its own named tunnel to staging.<domain>, an Access app with the same email list and the staging-probe service token, the GitHub staging token (Actions read, Contents read), a staging superuser with MFA, and scripts/seed-staging run once; from the staging LXC a LAN host, the Proxmox UI and the prod LXC are unreachable, and from the dev VM the staging LXC is unreachable (docs/evidence/m0.txt)

Access: one app on the whole hostname with an Emails include list, a 7-day session, one-time PIN and no Bypass; a second app on /_/ for Kayden's email only; the uptime-probe service token; X-ACC-01 to X-ACC-04 pass (security.md 'Access checks')
SMTP set in PocketBase with SPF and DKIM on the domain; the sign-in values (decisions.md 2026-10-07) set on prod and staging and recorded in ops.md §14
Superuser created with MFA; at least two test members invited, each with a name (ops.md §9)

The pipeline installed from docs/drafts/: ci.yml in .github/workflows/, the ci check required on main, the pre-push hook (git config core.hooksPath .githooks), the staging systemd units; .githooks/ added to the user-level guard hook's protected paths and an Edit(./.githooks/**) deny added to .claude/settings.json

The staging timer deploys a green main build on its own; that commit is then tagged, the release job attaches the same bundle, and deploy.sh <tag> puts it on prod with its deploy-log line (ops.md §13)

description: Kayden: 15-minute idle live-update soak through the real named tunnel and Access
steps: Phone on mobile data, signed in through Access and PocketBase, live list open and idle for 15 minutes
A catch verified in the admin UI after the idle period appears within 5 seconds (X-ACC-05)
The page recovers after the phone is locked and unlocked
Output and observations pasted into docs/evidence/m0.txt

description: Kayden: encrypted offsite backups that restore, and an uptime alert that reaches the phone
steps: restic (decided 2026-10-07) set up on the host: one repository in the B2 bucket, its password in a root-only file and on the break-glass sheet, retention as in ops.md §7
Nightly vzdump plus a PocketBase backup on the host; restic encrypts and pushes to B2; no container holds a B2 key
A backup is restored from B2 with restic on the host into a throwaway container, which serves the app; restic check passes
Cron in the LXC probes the public URL every 5 minutes with the service token and pings Healthchecks on 200; a deliberate outage alerts Kayden's phone
Healthchecks staging check: one deliberately broken build merged to main makes the staging deploy fail its smoke test, roll back and alert Kayden's phone; the fix is merged after
Results pasted into docs/evidence/m0.txt

description: Kayden: check the M0 exit gate before any S1 work
steps: A phone on mobile data sees a catch entered in the admin UI appear live, including after the phone is locked and unlocked
After a 15-minute idle subscription through the real tunnel, a newly verified catch renders within 5 seconds
An unlisted email is denied by Access, and an anonymous API write is denied
Connections from the prod and staging containers to the home LAN and to Proxmox management fail, and neither container nor the dev VM reaches the others
A backup reached B2 and restored
Staging deployed a green main build on its own, and prod runs that same bundle through a tag
The photo spike's result is recorded in decisions.md
Every earlier M0 item passes; docs/evidence/m0.txt holds the evidence

description: A member signs in, joins a live tournament and submits a catch with the two required photos; it is stored as pending with no location data, and the angler can edit, add photos to or retract it while it is pending
steps: Fixtures K, O, S, N, M, W, X, Y and events E1, E2, EL, ED, EC, EF are seeded from security.md 'Test fixtures'; every rules test also runs with Access absent (invariant 8)

Sign-in is PocketBase OTP only: password sign-in is refused and an OTP request for an unlisted email creates no user (R-USR-A-01, R-USR-A-02); anonymous sign-up and member user-create are refused (R-USR-C-01, R-USR-C-02, R-USR-C-03)

Sign-in values as in ops.md §14 (decisions.md 2026-10-07): the code screen offers "Send a new code" after 60 s; when the app opens with a valid token it refreshes it, so a member who opens the app within 14 days isn't asked for a code; an expired or invalid token goes to SYS-04
Users: anon sees none, M sees only own record and can't view X's, K sees all (R-USR-L-01, R-USR-L-02, R-USR-L-03, R-USR-V-01, R-USR-V-02)

Profile: M changes own name and display units but not role, email, verified or anyone else's record; K can't change roles; nobody deletes a user (R-USR-U-01, R-USR-U-02, R-USR-U-03, R-USR-U-04, R-USR-U-05, R-USR-D-01)
A signed-in member lists species and non-draft events; anon sees none; M can't view a draft (R-SPC-L-01, R-SPC-L-02, R-SPC-L-03, R-EVT-L-01, R-EVT-L-02, R-EVT-V-01)

Join: X joins E1 and gets display_name and a join audit row; joining as someone else, twice, in ED/EC/EF, after submit_deadline, anonymously, or with server-only fields is refused (R-ENT-C-01 to R-ENT-C-07, R-AUD-H-02); K and S were entered when E1 was created, so joining again fails and leaves one entry each (R-ENT-C-08, R-EVT-C-08)
Entries list: anon none; M sees non-withdrawn entries and not W's; W sees own withdrawn entry (R-ENT-L-01, R-ENT-L-02, R-ENT-L-03, R-ENT-L-04)

Withdraw and rejoin self: allowed in E1 and EC with a withdraw row; rejoin only after self-withdrawal, while E1 is live and before the deadline; W can't undo K's withdrawal; M can't touch X's entry or change event, angler, display_name or withdrawn_by; nobody deletes an entry (R-ENT-U-01 to R-ENT-U-06, R-ENT-U-11, R-ENT-D-01)

Submit: M picks a species from E1's list, enters 3 lb 7 oz and attaches the two required photos (holding the fish; on the scale) with photo_captured_at; the record is pending with rev 1, weight_hoz 5500 and a create audit row with the fixed snapshot; one photo or none is refused, and photo_captured_at must have one entry per file with the first equal to captured_at (R-CAT-C-01, R-CAT-C-19, R-CAT-C-21, R-AUD-H-01, R-AUD-H-05; scoring.md examples 5, 24); K and S submit to their own entries the same way (R-CAT-C-18)
Length entry in EL: 17 5/8 in is stored as length_q 70 and 14 7/8 in as 59 (scoring.md example 6)

Refused create bodies: another angler's entry, status, judged_by, reason or flags, rev, before starts_at, after submit_deadline, non-live event, anonymous, wrong measurement for the metric, withdrawn entry; a body-set created never sticks (R-CAT-C-02 to R-CAT-C-08, R-CAT-C-11 to R-CAT-C-15, R-CAT-C-23)
Species blocked: the submit screen offers only E1's species and the API refuses walleye in E1 (R-CAT-C-09; scoring.md example 7)

Club rules (RULES-01a): read only, worded from the scoring.md version in force; opened from a tournament page it adds that tournament's species, metric, fishing window, final deadline (with the extension note) and whether the code word is on; opened from home, club-wide rules only (decisions.md 2026-10-07, Gap 37)
Double submit: the same client_uuid twice leaves one record (R-CAT-C-10); the UI shows Sending, Received and NOT SENT with Retry, and a retry after a lost response confirms the catch by client_uuid

Photos: for the four fixtures (gps.jpg, xmp-gps.jpg, iphone.heic, text-chunk.png) neither the stored original nor any thumbnail has location data (test/upload.test.ts); an oversize or non-image file is refused (R-CAT-C-16)

Flags set on create, as fixed codes: no_capture_time, before_window, after_window, late_submit, extra_photo_no_time and extra_photo_far, exactly the matching ones and none on a clean catch (R-CAT-C-20, R-CAT-C-22; scoring.md examples 13, 14, 17, 25)

Edit while pending: M edits own weight_hoz (rev + 1, edit row); edits to another species, after judging, after the deadline or in EC, setting status other than retracted, reason or rev, on Y's catch, on a withdrawn entry, with the wrong measurement, anonymously, or changing captured_at are refused (R-CAT-U-16 to R-CAT-U-20, R-CAT-U-22 to R-CAT-U-25, R-CAT-U-28); every edit echoes the current rev, and a missing or stale rev is refused with no audit row (R-CAT-U-39)

Add photos: a third photo sent with the current rev keeps photos 1 and 2 in place, adds photo_added (and extra_photo_no_time or extra_photo_far when it applies), bumps rev and writes an edit row; earlier capture times can't change; a retried upload whose first attempt landed, or two simultaneous adds, add the photo once; removing or replacing a photo deletes nothing and is refused; a 5th photo or a non-JPEG over 5 MB is refused (R-CAT-U-21, R-CAT-U-26, R-CAT-U-27, R-CAT-U-34 to R-CAT-U-36, R-CAT-U-39, R-CAT-U-40)

Retract: M retracts own pending catch (retract row, hidden from others, never scores); retract after judging or after the deadline and un-retract are refused (R-CAT-U-29, R-CAT-U-30, R-CAT-U-32; scoring.md example 20)

Visibility: anon sees no catches; M sees pending and verified catches on non-withdrawn entries, own rejected catch with its reason, own retracted catch and, for W, own catches on the withdrawn entry; not others' rejected or retracted catches or W's; photos need a file token and follow the view rule (R-CAT-L-01 to R-CAT-L-04, R-CAT-L-07, R-CAT-L-10 to R-CAT-L-12, R-CAT-V-01, R-CAT-F-01, R-CAT-F-02, R-CAT-F-03)
Nothing is deleted and denied requests write no audit row (R-CAT-D-01, R-AUD-H-04)

Sweeps over all six collections pass and are re-run in every later slice: anonymous view/create/update/delete all denied; view by id matches each caller's list; delete denied for every role (R-ALL-ANON-01, R-ALL-V-01, R-ALL-D-01)
Submit, edit and Join screens checked at 390 px wide, primary buttons about 48 px tall, light high-contrast theme
npm run check output shown; /security-review run on the rules, hooks and upload code

description: The leaderboard shows the S2a scoring module's standings live in each member's display units
steps: Leaderboard rows show total, counted fish, biggest fish and pending count; only anglers with at least one pending or verified catch on a non-withdrawn entry appear (R-CAT-L-02, R-CAT-L-07, R-ENT-L-03)
Display units: decimal pounds and pounds-and-ounces views match scoring.md examples 5 and 16, and switching changes no score or ranking (R-USR-U-01)
Name sync: M's name change updates display_name in live and closed events but not in final ones (R-USR-U-06)

Realtime: a member subscribed to catches gets no event for another angler's rejected catch (R-CAT-L-09); the board refetches on PB_CONNECT and when the tab becomes visible, shows Live / Reconnecting / last updated, and polls every 30 s after 150 s of silence
Leaderboard checked at 390 px wide; npm run check output shown

description: The judge and backup judge work a queue with flags: approve, reject with a reason, correct to the photo, or re-judge, against the current rev, with every change audited; the organizer can withdraw or reinstate anglers
steps: Queue: K sees every catch in E1, including rejected, and in every event; S sees rejected catches only where the angler is K or S (R-CAT-L-05, R-CAT-L-06, R-CAT-L-08)

Flags shown in the queue as their fixed codes (no_capture_time, before_window, after_window, late_submit, photo_added, extra_photo_no_time, extra_photo_far) with hours from capture to receipt; judging a flagged catch leaves flags unchanged (R-CAT-C-20, R-CAT-U-38; scoring.md examples 13, 14, 17, 25)

Approve, reject and correct: approve with the current rev sets judged_by and writes an approve row; reject needs a reason; a correction needs a reason, sets the catch verified and writes exactly one correct row with before and after, from pending, verified or rejected; correct and reject can't be combined; a judge update that only rewrites the reason is refused (R-CAT-U-01 to R-CAT-U-05, R-CAT-U-41, R-CAT-U-44, R-CAT-U-45; scoring.md example 15)

No self-judging and backup scope: K can't approve own catch; S approves K's catch in E1 only, not M's and not in E2; M can't approve Y's; O, an organizer who isn't the judge, can't judge (R-CAT-U-06 to R-CAT-U-10, R-CAT-U-46; scoring.md examples 12 and 18); outside catches and audit_log, S and N get exactly what an ordinary member gets (R-ALL-S-01)
Stale rev: K's approval after M edited the catch is refused and the queue reloads it (R-CAT-U-13)

Re-judge: verified to rejected with a reason in a live or closed event is allowed and audited; the standings re-cull; changing a decision needs a reason either way, and a re-approval shows in the catch history (R-CAT-U-11, R-CAT-U-42, R-CAT-U-43, R-AUD-L-07; scoring.md examples 21, 26)

Judge guards: status other than verified or rejected, server-only fields, a photo or photo_captured_at in the body, and any action on a retracted catch are refused (R-CAT-U-14, R-CAT-U-15, R-CAT-U-31, R-CAT-U-33, R-CAT-U-37)

Audit visibility: anon none; M reads every row of the catches M can see (own, and others' pending or verified catches on non-withdrawn entries, including an overturned rejection), every row of own rejected and retracted catches, and no event or entry rows; others' rejected or retracted catches and catches on W's entry stay hidden; K sees all; S sees rows for K's catches plus own and what any member sees; after a step-down, a judge without the organizer role reads every row of the catches they judge; nobody creates, updates or deletes audit rows (R-AUD-L-01 to R-AUD-L-09, R-AUD-C-01, R-AUD-C-02, R-AUD-U-01, R-AUD-U-02, R-AUD-D-01)
Every approve, reject and correct writes exactly one row with actor, catch, event, before and after, with the fixed snapshot fields (R-AUD-H-01, R-AUD-H-05)

Organizer screen: K lists all entries, withdraws M only with a reason and reinstates W, each with an audit row; K withdraws own entry with no reason, and withdraws or reinstates in a closed event; S can't withdraw anyone, and still sees K's entry after K withdraws (R-ENT-L-05, R-ENT-L-06, R-ENT-U-13, R-ENT-U-14, R-ENT-U-07, R-ENT-U-08, R-ENT-U-09, R-ENT-U-12; scoring.md example 19)

Judge photos and code word: K and S fetch rejected photos within their scope with a file token, N can't (R-CAT-F-04); when the code word changed within 24 h of photo 1, the review shows code_word_prev and code_word with the time of the change (scoring.md example 27)
Judge tab: the Judging home lists every live or closed tournament the viewer judges or backup-judges, stacked, with pending counts (R-CAT-L-05, R-CAT-L-06)
Outage: the queue shows hours from capture to receipt so the judge can apply the outage allowance from the outage log (scoring.md example 22)
Queue checked at 390 px wide; npm run check output shown; /security-review run

description: The organizer runs the tournament lifecycle (create, open, close, finalize), the event locks, results and audit CSVs are hashed for the group chat, and photos are archived and removed outside the API
steps: Create and edit: K sees drafts and creates a draft whose submit_deadline is ends_at + 24 h; members and S can't create or update events; live status, a body-set submit_deadline, or judge = backup_judge on create or update are refused; any field can change on a draft; nobody deletes an event; the judge must hold the organizer role on create and on any change; the judge and backup judge are entered automatically; a body can't set the code word history (R-EVT-L-03, R-EVT-C-01 to R-EVT-C-05, R-EVT-C-07 to R-EVT-C-10, R-EVT-U-16, R-EVT-U-17, R-EVT-U-01, R-EVT-U-02, R-EVT-U-11, R-EVT-D-01)
Species: K adds walleye; members can't; duplicate names fail; nobody renames or deletes a species (R-SPC-C-01, R-SPC-C-02, R-SPC-C-03, R-SPC-U-01, R-SPC-U-02, R-SPC-D-01)

Live edits: metric, best_n, species, starts_at and judge are locked once live; name, the code word, backup_judge and ends_at (later only, while the window is open) can change, audited, with the deadline recomputed; a code word change on a live event stores the previous word and when it changed. Once closed, only backup_judge can change, and the new backup judge gets no entry (R-EVT-U-03, R-EVT-U-04, R-EVT-U-18, R-EVT-U-20 to R-EVT-U-24, R-EVT-U-27 to R-EVT-U-29)

Lifecycle: draft to live writes an open row; close before submit_deadline, final with a pending catch, skipping a step and going backward are refused; every status change or live edit writes one row; Open is refused until the draft is complete (R-EVT-U-06 to R-EVT-U-10, R-EVT-U-25, R-AUD-H-03)

Outage extension: K extends the final deadline by the outage length without moving ends_at, and a fish photographed after ends_at is still flagged while the event is live, never lowering it and never on a draft or closed event; a body can't set it on create; each change is an event_edit row; the extension is set in whole hours, and raising it after the deadline reopens joining and submitting (R-EVT-C-06, R-EVT-U-12 to R-EVT-U-15, R-EVT-U-26, R-CAT-C-17; scoring.md example 23)

Judge step-down, as a superuser step in its own test file: S becomes judge of E1 without the organizer role and N backup judge; N gets an entry; S then reads every audit row of the catches S judges (R-EVT-U-19, R-AUD-L-08; scoring.md example 28)
Final lock: no change to any catch, entry or event in EF through the API (R-CAT-U-12, R-ENT-U-10, R-EVT-U-05; invariant 7)

Exports: the results CSV is built in the organizer's browser by web/src/lib/scoring.ts and matches the leaderboard; the audit CSV covers every audit row for the event; the screen shows the SHA-256 of each, ready to post with the standings in the group chat, and the same data always gives the same hash
Final events show 'Photo archived' and the app never requests their photo files

archive-event.sh, run on a seeded copy: copies every photo of the event with a sha256 manifest, stops if any file has location metadata, and removes files from pb_data only after the desktop copy's manifest verifies, never through the API (invariant 6)
npm run check output shown; the ops.md 'Close and finalize' checklist walked once against a seeded event
